}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== Device consists of [[Luckfox_Core3576_4GB/32GB]] mounted on :carrier board in an aluminum alloy case.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3576 [[ARM]] ([[big.LITTLE]]) :Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A72) @2.2GHz + :Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A53) @1.8GHz :• NPU: 6 TOPS @INT8 (2 NPU core) :• GPU: ''Mali-G52 MC3'' @900MHz (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.0); :• VPU (with 8K @30fps VP9 and H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 32GB ([https://en.shichuangyi.com/qianrushicunchuxinpian/26.html eMMC 5.1]) Flash, :TF Card (max. 256GB)/MMC Card slot *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4x) RAM ([[Rayson]]) *USB: 1x USB 3.2 Gen1, 1x USB 2.0, :1x USB (Type-C) 3.0 (DP1.4/OTG) ports *mPCIe: 1x M.2 2280 (Key M) slot for :1x NVMe SSD (PCIe 2.1 1-lane) *Wi-Fi: [[AIC]] AIC8800D80 (SDIO 3.0) :802.11ac/ax (1T1R), Bluetooth 5.2 (BLE) *Network: 2x GbE ports *GPIO: 1x 40-pin connector *Power Source: USB (Type-C) 5V/3A
